# HyperFrames runtime

`hyperframe.runtime.iife.js` is the HyperFrames browser runtime, copied unchanged from the `hyperframes` npm package,
version 0.9.56 (https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes). It is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0), included here as `LICENSE`. Copyright HeyGen and the HyperFrames contributors.

Final Phase Lite loads it into your composition in the live preview, so the video plays exactly the way HyperFrames
renders it.
